thread:
Alex M.: Quick sync — proposing we bump API / runtime / console / SDKs to v0.16.0 tomorrow at 10:00am PT. Scope: API surface stable, runtime kv-cache perf patch, console changelog + telemetry flag, SDKs include the breaking client fix we merged earlier. Anyone on this timeline?
Priya: I'm good with the timeline. Changelog draft is at https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/483 — will land after final review. Can we hold the console PR until API tag exists?
Sam: Runtime PR is green on CI but needs one ACK for the kernel-selection tweak from Kyle. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1122
Kyle: On it, will review in ~45m. I left one inline question about the compatibility test.
Jen: SDKs: client bump PR created — https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk-js/pull/870. There's a failing test related to retry behavior, I'm looking into a minimal fix now.
Alex M.: Thanks. Two coordination asks: (1) tag API and console only after runtime has the release note entry added (so docs don't mismatch), (2) if SDK tests still flake, we should consider a decoupled SDK minor (v0.16.1) after main cut.
Priya: Agree on (1). I can gate changelog merge on runtime note. Also will update the release checklist in the console PR.
Jen: Pushed a small test change to my branch, CI rerunning. If green, I'll request reviews. If not, I'll open a follow-up PR for v0.16.1 plan.
release-bot: Reminder: scheduled cutoff window closes 60 minutes before release time. Run `./scripts/check-release.sh` and ensure no failing checks.
Sam: FYI I added the KV-cache compatibility blurb to the runtime release notes: "kv-cache API remains backward compatible; default eviction param changed" — link in PR description.
Kyle: Reviewed runtime, left one nit. Approving after tests are green. :thumbsup:
Jen: CI passed — requested reviews.
Alex M.: OK — final checklist: API tag (alex) after runtime merge; runtime merge once Kyle approves; console changelog merge gated on API tag; SDK merge if tests green, else postpone and cut v0.16.1 patch later. If anyone needs to shift the 10:00 PT slot, raise it now.
Priya: All set from docs side.
Kyle: Approving now.
Sam: Merged runtime.
Alex M.: Merging API now and tagging `v0.16.0-api` so console can reference it. After tag I'll post back here.
Alex M.: Tag pushed: `v0.16.0-api` — console team you can proceed.
Priya: Console changelog merged.
Jen: SDK merged, will keep an eye on post-release errors.
Alex M.: Great work everyone. I'll hit the final release cut at 10:00am PT — I'll post a confirmation here when the full rollout is started. :rocket:
